title: Arrested man choked on vomit
article: Ben Robert Matson, 49, of Burnaby, has been identified by police as the man who died shortly after being arrested by Vancouver police Sunday.
Detective Driemel said preliminary autopsy findings indicate the man choked on his vomit. Additional forensic tests are being made to determine the exact cause of death.

Police first said he went into cardiac arrest at the time he was subdued. Police say officers responded to a report of a man with a knife in the 600-block Davie at about 2:20 a.m. Matson was then arrested after a brief chase, but was rushed to hospital because he was having difficulty breathing.

He died shortly after. Driemel said a full investigation is being conducted by major crime detectives, as is the case with all deaths of people in custody. Driemel said the officers only used physical force to subdue the man, whose family has not yet been notified. Driemel couldn't provide any more detail, including whether or not the man actually had a knife. He said about 40 witnesses have already been interviewed.
